subject: Vector bridge: code escrow, on-call rota & shared SLA
messages:
From: Brenda Lopez <brenda@pinecone.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Cc: Jurgen Ops <jurgen.ops@pinecone.io>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Vector bridge - proposal for code escrow + joint on-call

Hi Hannah,

Following up from last week's call — Pinecone legal/ops want to put a lightweight code-escrow and joint on-call agreement in place for the vector-store bridge we'll be shipping into Redwood Dedicated customers. The ask is narrow: code escrow for fallback loader logic and a shared on-call rota for 24x7 critical incidents that affect indexing or query availability.

Attached: redwood-pinecone-escrow-term-sheet.docx (term sheet draft). Annex A is a suggested SLA matrix we use with large partners.

Questions for Redwood:
- Do you have a preferred escrow vendor (e.g., Iron Mountain / EscrowCo) or should we propose two and let legal pick?
- Proposed SLOs we should align on: 99.5% indexing availability, 99.8% query availability for the low-latency tier. Do those hit your ops bar?
- Are you ok with a single shared on-call rotation (Pinecone + Redwood engineers) for P1s with 30-min ack window?

If you prefer, we can run a short 45m sync with legal/ops and map to your security checklist.

Thanks,
Brenda
Partnerships, Pinecone
[attachment: redwood-pinecone-escrow-term-sheet.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Brenda Lopez <brenda@pinecone.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vector bridge - proposal for code escrow + joint on-call

Brenda — thanks for the clear draft and the ask. We want to move fast on this (security/compliance and commercial both want clarity before first pilot goes live). Quick answers and a couple asks below.

- Escrow vendor: Redwood Legal prefers a short list approach. Please send two vendor recommendations and we can run them through infosec. If you already have a standing relationship with one, include that option.
- SLO targets: your suggested numbers look reasonable as a starting point. Ops + CS will want an objective for mean time to recovery (MTTR) on P1s (we generally target <= 45 minutes for query-impacting incidents). Can you change the annex to list MTTR goals alongside availability numbers?
- On-call: we support a combined rotation for P1/P0 but want explicit escalation paths (who authorizes a customer-facing SLA credit, who triggers failover). Also need playbook for prefix cache warmup and data portability in scope.

Ben/Karthik/Vanessa — looping you in. Ben, can you review the term sheet draft for any technical redlines (escrow scope, what counts as "fallback loader logic"). Karthik, legal/compliance will need the vendor list and any residency/transfer constraints. Vanessa, can you own scheduling the joint ops sync next week and invite our CS lead?

Prefer meeting windows: Thu 8/14 10-11am PT or Fri 8/15 9-10am PT. Let me know what works.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
[redwood.com]

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Brenda Lopez <brenda@pinecone.io>
Date: Wed, 13 Aug 2025 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vector bridge - proposal for code escrow + joint on-call

Hannah / team — quick technical notes after skimming the term sheet. Quoting Hannah below for context:

> Ben/Karthik/Vanessa — looping you in. Ben, can you review the term sheet draft for any technical redlines (escrow scope, what counts as "fallback loader logic").

A few concrete redlines/suggestions:
1) Escrow scope: we should explicitly enumerate the minimal artifacts to escrow — the fallback loader code, the connector config templates, migration scripts for index metadata, and a test harness that can validate index integrity on a target S3/PGVector backend. Don’t escrow the full Pinecone service code.
2) Access conditions: escrow release should be limited to sustained, unresolved P1(s) that materially impact customer SLAs and after 3 business days of joint remediation attempts. This avoids premature release.
3) Data residency: ensure escrowed artifacts do not contain any customer data. Add a verification step in the term sheet that owners sanitize any test fixtures.
4) On-call rotation: propose a two-tier model — level 1 is vendor ops (Pinecone + Redwood runbook owners) with 30-min ack; level 2 is engineering leads with 2-hour bridge requirement. Add explicit contact role names in the runbook.

I attached a short draft XLS with an on-call rota template and Annex A updated with MTTR fields. Also attached: annex-A-sla.pdf (redlines).

Operational asks for Pinecone: please confirm the hashes/paths of the artifacts you intend to escrow and the escrow vendor choices. For the pilot we can do a temporary non-binding escrow with a 6-month review.

Ben
Senior SW Eng, Runtime
Redwood Inference
[attachment: oncall-rotation-draft.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
[attachment: annex-A-sla.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Jurgen Ops <jurgen.ops@pinecone.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Brenda Lopez <brenda@pinecone.io>
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 16:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vector bridge - proposal for code escrow + joint on-call

Hannah / Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear redlines. Reply below and next steps.

On the vendor list: we can provide Iron Mountain and EscrowCo as two recommended providers. I'll include vendor contact and estimated fees in the package.

On the escrow scope: agreed with your enumeration — we'll prepare a zipped artifact with clear manifest (no customer PII, checksummed). We'll also add the 3-business-day joint-remediation gating before release.

On SLOs/MTTR: okay to include MTTR fields in Annex A. For the pilot we accept the proposed MTTR <= 45m for query-impacting P1s; indexing may be allowed a slightly higher MTTR (<= 90m) given rebuild windows. We'll mark those in the annex and send a final PDF.

On-call model: we like Ben's two-tier approach. Request: Pinecone will own the initial pager rotation for the first 30 days of pilot while we stabilize; after that we'll shift to a joint rotation. We'll document the transition milestone in the runbook.

Next steps we propose:
- I will send the vendor contact + fee estimate by EOD Mon 8/18.
- Brenda will update term sheet to reflect MTTR + gating language and circulate a new PDF.
- Schedule the joint ops sync: Thu 8/21 10-11am PT — Vanessa, can you confirm and send calendar invite to Ops, CS, Legal?

Forwarding the latest annex (with our comments) and a stub runbook link for the sync: https://drive.google.com/open?id=shared-runbook-abc123

Thanks — Jurgen
Pinecone Operations
